transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

For the past year, I've had this overwhelming amount of energy and barely need any sleep to feel completely refreshed. But my mood is all over the place, jumping from feeling absolutely amazing to getting incredibly irritated at the slightest things. I just feel like I constantly have to keep moving!
During these times of high energy, have you ever experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things others can't, or having strong beliefs that others told you weren't real?

Yes, but those things only happen when my energy is super high like this. I'll hear voices whispering and see things that aren't actually there, and I get convinced that I have special powers or that people are plotting against me.
Have you ever experienced those voices, visions, or beliefs during times when your mood and energy were completely normal? If so, did that last for at least two weeks?
No, never. Those voices and beliefs only show up when my energy is through the roof and my mood is super high. When I'm feeling normal, none of those things happen at all.
